introduction: South Dakota energy assistance accepts online or paper applications. Make sure the household application has the required adult signatures.
description: South Dakota energy assistance accepts online or paper applications. Make sure the household application has the required adult signatures.

sections.who: The state reviews income, household size and responsibility for heating costs.
sections.get: Approved heating payments go to the energy supplier.
sections.docs:
• Prior three calendar months of household income.
  • Heating and electric bills or landlord heating statement.
  • Required adult signatures.
sections.apply:
1. Apply through DSS

    Use the energy application links.

  2. Provide records

    Submit income and heating evidence using the agency instructions.

  3. Flag a crisis

    Call 800-233-8503 about a disconnect notice or fuel shortage.
sections.after: Watch mailed decisions and document requests; use the agency status option if needed.
sections.sources: Checked October 1, 2026 using Heating assistance and crisis intake. USA Assistance background guide. Program staff determine eligibility and available assistance.

faqs: The state pays the energy supplier.
What if heat is in my rent?
The checklist accepts a landlord statement explaining heating charges.
Should I mention a disconnect notice?
Yes. Contact the energy office about crisis screening.

provenance.scope: Published eligibility, service purpose and application pathway; no unverified financial limits or deadlines included.
